title: From the Brink of Death to Divine Intervention
description: Join us as we explore the powerful story of one believer's encounter with spiritual warfare and their incredible testimony of God's protection and healing. You'll be inspired by the pastor's unwavering faith and determination to stand on the promises of God, even in the face of overwhelming physical and spiritual attacks. Don't miss this powerful sermon that will challenge and encourage you to trust in God's goodness and sovereignty, no matter what you may be facing.
